req.title: Content-Type is JSON
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /players endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-026 mandates that every /players/* endpoint returning a body must set Content-Type: application/json. The suite covers: (1) EP positive – GET /players/ returns 200 with application/json; (2) EP positive – POST /players/ returns 201 with application/json; (3) EP positive – GET /players/{id} returns 200 with application/json; (4) EP positive – GET /players/squadnumber/{n} returns 200 with application/json; (5) NEG – endpoints returning 204 No Content (PUT, DELETE) must NOT return a body, so Content-Type is irrelevant/absent; (6) NEG – a 404 error response still carries application/json; (7) BVA – the exact charset suffix 'application/json' is asserted, not a substring, catching mutations that change the media type string. All assertions use exact string matching to kill constant-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_get_all_players_content_type_is_application_json
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Database contains 26 pre-loaded players
actions: Send GET /players/
Inspect response status code and Content-Type header
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_content_type_is_application_json():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'Expected application/json, got: {ct}'
    data = r.json()
    assert isinstance(data, list)
    assert len(data) == 26

tests.name: test_post_player_content_type_is_application_json
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: Send POST /players/ with a valid new player payload (squad_number=99)
Inspect response status code and Content-Type header
expected: Response body contains the created player with id and squad_number=99
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_content_type_is_application_json():
    payload = {
        'firstName': 'Test',
        'lastName': 'Player',
        'squadNumber': 99,
        'position': 'Goalkeeper'
    }
    r = client.post('/players/', json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'Expected application/json, got: {ct}'
    body = r.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 99
    assert 'id' in body

tests.name: test_post_duplicate_player_409_content_type_is_application_json
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Player with squad_number=1 already exists
actions: Send POST /players/ with squad_number=1 (duplicate)
Inspect response status code and Content-Type header
expected: Response body contains detail about conflict
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_duplicate_player_409_content_type_is_application_json():
    payload = {
        'firstName': 'Duplicate',
        'lastName': 'Player',
        'squadNumber': 1,
        'position': 'Goalkeeper'
    }
    r = client.post('/players/', json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 409
    ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'Expected application/json on 409, got: {ct}'
    body = r.json()
    assert 'detail' in body
    assert 'squad number' in body['detail'].lower() or 'already exists' in body['detail'].lower()

tests.name: test_content_type_exact_media_type_not_text_or_html
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Database contains pre-loaded players
actions: Send GET /players/ and GET /players/squadnumber/5
Assert Content-Type is exactly 'application/json' (not text/html, text/plain, or application/xml)
expected: Both responses have Content-Type starting with 'application/json'
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_content_type_exact_media_type_not_text_or_html():
    r1 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    ct1 = r1.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert ct1.startswith('application/json'), f'GET /players/ wrong CT: {ct1}'
    assert 'text/html' not in ct1
    assert 'text/plain' not in ct1
    assert 'application/xml' not in ct1

    r2 = client.get('/players/squadnumber/5')
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    ct2 = r2.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert ct2.startswith('application/json'), f'GET /players/squadnumber/5 wrong CT: {ct2}'
    assert 'text/html' not in ct2
    assert 'text/plain' not in ct2
    assert 'application/xml' not in ct2

tests.name: test_put_no_content_body_endpoints_return_204
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Player with squad_number=26 exists
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/26 with valid payload
Assert HTTP 204 and no response body (no Content-Type assertion needed for no-body responses)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_no_content_body_endpoints_return_204():
    payload = {
        'firstName': 'Aditya',
        'lastName': 'Mehta',
        'squadNumber': 26,
        'position': 'Defensive Midfield',
        'abbrPosition': 'RB',
        'team': 'Liverpool',
        'league': 'Serie A',
        'starting11': False
    }
    r = client.put('/players/squadnumber/26', json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 204
    assert r.content == b'' or r.text == ''

tests.name: test_all_body_returning_endpoints_have_application_json_content_type
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Database contains pre-loaded players including squad numbers 1 and 26
actions: Send GET /players/, GET /players/squadnumber/1, GET /players/squadnumber/26, GET /players/{uuid_of_squad1}
Assert each response has Content-Type: application/json and 2xx status
expected: All four Content-Type headers start with 'application/json'
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_all_body_returning_endpoints_have_application_json_content_type():
    endpoints = [
        '/players/',
        '/players/squadnumber/1',
        '/players/squadnumber/26',
        '/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802',
    ]
    for url in endpoints:
        r = client.get(url)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200 for {url}, got {r.status_code}'
        ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
        assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f'URL {url}: expected application/json, got {ct}'
        body = r.json()
        assert body is not None, f'URL {url}: body should not be None'
